queries.query: why Ishtar must surrender a piece of her attire at each of the seven gates as she goes down to her sister Ereshkigal, queen of the dead
queries.note: The seven-gate stripping; 'land of no return', 'loin-cloth', 'spangles', 'girdle studded with birth-stones' paraphrased away; Ishtar and Ereshkigal kept as names.

queries.query: how can someone imprisoned in the realm of the dead be released and restored
queries.note: The waters of life and the return through the gates; release from the underworld is answered by many traditions. No target — graded post-hoc.
